nodes.title: Security officers appointed
nodes.description: A chief security officer and a security officer are named, have done the training Defence asks for, and are known to Defence.

nodes.title: Security policy and plan
nodes.description: A security policy and a security plan cover the business's Defence work, are approved by its leaders and are reviewed at least once a year.

nodes.title: Foreign ownership, control or influence
nodes.description: Foreign ownership, control or influence over the business is declared, and changes to it are told to Defence.

nodes.title: Annual security report
nodes.description: The yearly security report is sent to Defence on time, and changes to the business that affect membership are reported as they happen.

nodes.title: Supply chain security
nodes.description: Suppliers and subcontractors who touch Defence information or work are assessed, and their contracts carry the security obligations down.

nodes.title: Security risk management
nodes.description: Security risks to the Defence work are identified, assessed and treated under an approved method.

nodes.title: Security clearances
nodes.description: Staff who need a security clearance hold one at the right level, the register of clearances is reviewed, and none has lapsed unnoticed.

nodes.title: Pre-employment screening
nodes.description: Identity, right to work and background are checked before a new starter gets access to Defence information or sites.

nodes.title: Separation
nodes.description: When someone leaves, their access ends promptly and Defence is told where a clearance was sponsored.

nodes.title: Security awareness training
nodes.description: Everyone completes security awareness training when they start and every year, and the training is kept current.

nodes.title: Contact reporting
nodes.description: Staff report suspicious, ongoing or unusual contacts, and the security officer passes them to Defence.

nodes.title: Visitor control
nodes.description: Visitors are signed in, identified, escorted where needed and signed out, and the record is kept.

nodes.title: Access control
nodes.description: Keys, cards and codes to the site and its secure areas are given only to those who need them, and are reviewed.

nodes.title: Facility security plan
nodes.description: A facility security plan covers each site doing Defence work, and secure areas and containers meet the standard their information needs.

nodes.title: Classification and handling
nodes.description: Defence information is marked with its classification and stored, sent and destroyed as its marking requires.

nodes.title: Security incident reporting
nodes.description: Security incidents, including cyber incidents, are reported to Defence and to ASD within the times they set.

nodes.title: Incident and contact records
nodes.description: A record is kept of each security incident and contact report sent to Defence.

nodes.title: Application control
nodes.description: Only approved applications run on the systems that handle Defence information, as the Essential Eight describes.

nodes.title: Patch applications
nodes.description: Applications on those systems are patched within the Essential Eight's time frames, and unsupported ones are removed.

nodes.title: Restrict Microsoft Office macros
nodes.description: Office macros are blocked unless needed and checked, as the Essential Eight describes.

nodes.title: User application hardening
nodes.description: Web browsers, Office and PDF software are hardened as the Essential Eight describes.

nodes.title: Restrict administrative privileges
nodes.description: Administrative privileges are limited, validated and separated from everyday use, as the Essential Eight describes.

nodes.title: Patch operating systems
nodes.description: Operating systems are patched within the Essential Eight's time frames, and unsupported ones are replaced.

nodes.title: Multi-factor authentication
nodes.description: Multi-factor authentication protects users and administrators as the Essential Eight describes.

nodes.title: Regular backups
nodes.description: Important data is backed up, protected and restore-tested as the Essential Eight describes.
